executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $162.85 per resident day (42.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $9,940,947 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 35,825 Medicaid days, $277.49 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $282.13 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $293.64 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -12.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $913,048, 12.6% of the $7,266,717 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,210,365, $27.12 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $1,210,365 (100.0%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($1,196,562), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $786,475, $17.63 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $786,475 (100.0%).

Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 laundry is not used: missing.; Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).; Cost year 2025: no laundry costs were read from the report.

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 3 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $198,550 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Interest Expense (page 27 line 12D), added $199,496; Other A&G Expenses (page 16 line m13), removed $694; Medical Director (page 13 line B8a), removed $252. Separately, the home itself removed $1,084,806 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
